WITH sales_2002_09 AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
),
ret AS (
  SELECT sum(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amt
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN sales_2002_09 s
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
   AND sr.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
),
sale AS (
  SELECT sum(ss_net_paid) AS net_paid
  FROM sales_2002_09
)
SELECT round(ret.return_amt / sale.net_paid * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       ret.return_amt, sale.net_paid
FROM ret, sale
